Metadata.title: Francisco Gomar · Web design and development
Metadata.description: I design and build websites and digital products end to end: design, code and launch. Based in Buenos Aires, working worldwide.

Home.waText: Hi Francisco, I saw gom.ar and I'd like to talk about a project.
Home.h1: I build sites this fast for brands that need customers.
Home.cap: That's how long this page took to show up on your device. Your browser just measured it; it isn't an average.
Home.clockSr: This page took {s} seconds to show up.

svc.p: Design, development and launch. I pick the platform that fits: WordPress, HubSpot, Tienda Nube or custom Next.js.
App and platform redesigns with your product team, all the way to developer handoff.
So your brand looks the same on the site, social, email and in store.

Home.ai: I use AI to move faster, not to make your decisions.
Home.aiLead: I use it every day in real production work, with Claude, Higgsfield and image and video generation.
aiFast: More iterations in the same timeline
Images and video without a separate shoot
aiMine: The quality of the code that ships
That your brand looks like your brand
Home.bio: I'm Francisco Gomar, a designer and developer in San Isidro, Buenos Aires. Today I design the website, app and social channels for Megatlon. I work in Spanish and English, with brands here and abroad.
Home.fNote: Your email app opens with the message ready to send.
